ownership_reason: Only the gold walks the enclosing classes and decides which steps of the walk need an enclosing instance: hop 1 maps SecurityException and NullPointerException to null, hop 2 reports a class with an enclosing method as local/anonymous, hop 3 accepts every remaining class when allowNonStatic is true, and hop 4 only turns the gold's count into the kind String (non-zero: 'non-static member class'). On the trigger input (Integer.class, allowNonStatic false) every hop does what its javadoc says and the gold counts one enclosing instance for Integer, a top-level class, although an instance of Integer needs none, which its own contract ('the enclosing instances that have to exist before an instance of given class can be created') excludes. The convention is pinned outside the gold: ClassUtil.isNonStaticInnerClass takes the same step with both parts (not static AND an enclosing class exists), and AnnotatedClass.isNonStaticInnerClass delegates to it for BasicDeserializerFactory's creator collection, which skips all but the default constructor of a non-static inner class; without its enclosing-class half the top-level JDK classes java.util.ArrayList and java.util.LinkedHashMap are taken to need an enclosing instance and 305 tests fail, among them TestCreators2::testJackson431 and MapDeserializationTest::testKeyWithCreator. ClassUtil.getOuterClass returns the enclosing class of a non-static class, which is null for a top-level class, and BeanDeserializerBase._resolveInnerClassValuedProperty uses it to find the one-argument constructor that takes the single enclosing instance (TestInnerClass::testSimpleNonStaticInner); InnerClassCreatorTest::testIssue1501 exercises the non-static inner class path of isNonStaticInnerClass. A one-line edit above the gold that answers top-level classes itself (for example hop 4 testing ClassUtil.getEnclosingClass(type) == null before asking the gold, hop 3 accepting such classes, or hop 4 calling ClassUtil.isNonStaticInnerClass instead of the gold) passes the tests but is a second implementation of the gold's decision: for the trigger input the gold's answer is never used, and the gold keeps counting an enclosing instance for a top-level class. Making hop 4 report only counts above one also passes the tests but breaks hop 4's own documentation and drops every member class that needs exactly one enclosing instance. isLocalType had no javadoc in the original checkout; a one-sentence javadoc in ClassUtil's own wording is added so that the recipe's facade sentence has a javadoc to be appended to.
